title: Journeys First journey, v1
description: A journey: what a product promises a user, as plain sentences a person can review and any agent can run. The file is journeys/<name>.journey.yaml. `npx journeysfirst validate` also checks what this schema cannot: ids are unique within a step list, and two cases share a check id only when the check says the same thing.

format.description: Always journeysfirst/v1. v1 only gets additions, so v1 files keep working.

title.description: A one-line name, like "Share a presentation by link".

promise.description: What the person asked for, in their own words. Keep their whole blurb. For a list or paragraph, start the value with | and put the text on the lines below.

start.description: What is true before the first step. Required unless the journey has cases.

setup.description: The name of the app's setup script that creates the start state.

cases.description: Several ways the promise can happen, each with its own start and steps. Use cases or steps, not both.

notes.description: Anything an agent should know that is not a step.

sentence.description: Plain text. A value is written as ${name}, in lowercase with underscores.

id.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, like link-on. Written once; never changes.

users.description: Role words for the other users, like [viewer] or [editor, admin]. You are the main user and are not listed. Leave it out when only you act.

steps.description: One list, read top to bottom. Each step is a plain sentence, or a check with an id. At least one check.

check.description: What must be true at this point.

launcher_probe.description: Require a matching launcher preflight probe instead of a product login.

added.description: true when an agent added this check beyond what the person asked for.

case.description: One way the promise can happen.

name.description: How this case happens, in a few words.

start.description: What is true before this case's first step.

setup.description: The name of the app's setup script for this case.

added.description: true when an agent added this case.
